# Real photographic test fixtures

Downloaded from scikit-image v0.19.3 sample data:
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.19.3/skimage/data/astronaut.png
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.19.3/skimage/data/rocket.jpg

NASA public-domain imagery distributed by scikit-image (astronaut Eileen Collins
and rocket launch). Used only for development tests; not bundled in the app.
These are photographs, not synthetic model-accuracy ground truth. Region checks
and overlays are smoke tests, not segmentation benchmarks.
